description: This file defines the ClinicalAgent class which provides expert-style medical guideline-based suggestions, diagnostics, and supportive care recommendations based on user input and guideline retrieval via a vector store. Implements heuristic extraction of tests and medicines tailored to symptoms, with emphasis on safety and guidelines. Also includes a suggest method that returns a structured plan and a recommend method for flattened suggestions.

classes.name: ClinicalAgent
classes.description: Provides diagnostic tests, medicines, and notes suggestions based on guideline retrieval and heuristic symptom analysis.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the ClinicalAgent object and loads the guideline vector store.

methods.name: List[str] _extract_tests(self, user_query: str, retrieved_texts: List[str])
methods.description: Heuristically determines which diagnostic tests to suggest based on user symptoms and guideline content.

methods.name: List[str] _extract_medicines(self, user_query: str, retrieved_texts: List[str])
methods.description: Heuristically determines which medicines and supportive care measures to suggest based on symptoms and guideline keywords.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,str,float]] _rag(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3)
methods.description: Performs retrieval of guideline snippets from the vector store based on user query.

methods.name: List[str] _dedupe(self, items: List[str])
methods.description: Removes duplicate entries from a list of strings, case-insensitive, ignoring empties.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[str]] suggest(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3)
methods.description: Produces a structured guideline-based suggestions object including tests, medicines, and notes, with contextual reasoning and disclaimer.

methods.name: List[str] recommend(self, user_query: str, k: int = 3)
methods.description: Flattens the structured suggestions into a list of strings suitable for frontend display, ensuring disclaimer inclusion.
